title: Upper Power: Press
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Lateral Lunge × 6/side · Eccentric Push-Up with Extension × 5 · Bird Dog × 6/side
jumps: DB Bench Press 2 (heavy, RPE 8) → Plyometric Push-Up 4 → Med Ball Chest Pass 4 → Medicine Ball Slams 4
Rest 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds
note: Last power week: heaviest single of the block, much less volume. Every rep fast.
